answer: Because of that, capturing the pool presupposes several independent identities, and each of them needs its own established standing, which only comes from passing graded work. The summit cap is applied at the yarrow settlement and visible in the willow breakdown, which turns a pooling attack into a slow, expensive and publicly visible grind. A single identity may take at most 25% of an epoch's reward pool; anything above the cap is repooled or burned. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
